nodes.description: Public total token supply state variable declared in ERC20Interface and inherited by UBYToken.
Public token symbol string, set to 'UB' in the constructor.
Public token name string, set to 'Ucoin UBY' in the constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint256) of token balances mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spend allowances written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath division with zero-divisor assertion.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow assertion, used on balances and allowances.
SafeMath addition with overflow assertion, used on recipient balances.
UBYToken constructor: assigns metadata, computes totalSupply and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
Public view returning balances[tokenOwner].
Public transfer guarded by onlyPayloadSize(64); subtracts from sender and adds to recipient.
Public approve; overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] without zeroing (double-spend race).
Public transferFrom guarded by onlyPayloadSize(96); moves balances and decrements allowance.
Public view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts so ETH is never accepted.
Caller-controlled address, used as balance owner, allowance owner and minting recipient.
Arithmetic write in transfer reducing the caller balance via SafeMath.sub.
Arithmetic write in transfer increasing the recipient balance via SafeMath.add.
Unconditional allowance overwrite in approve, allowing the known approval double-spend race.
Arithmetic supply computation in the constructor (unchecked multiplication/exponentiation).
Arithmetic write in transferFrom reducing the source balance via SafeMath.sub.
Arithmetic write in transferFrom decrementing the caller allowance via SafeMath.sub.
Destination address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of transfer, approve and transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve and allowance.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Owner address parameter of balanceOf and allowance.

edges.reason: transfer executes the SafeMath.sub balance write.
transfer executes the SafeMath.add balance write.
approve executes the unconditional allowance overwrite.
transferFrom executes the source balance subtraction.
transferFrom executes the allowance subtraction.
transferFrom executes the destination balance addition.
constructor performs the totalSupply arithmetic assignment.
msg.sender indexes balances in the transfer subtraction.
msg.sender is the emitting owner of the transfer addition context.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
msg.sender receives the minted totalSupply in the constructor.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
to parameter indexes balances in the transfer addition.
tokens amount is subtracted from the caller balance.
tokens amount is added to the recipient balance.
tokens amount is stored into the allowance mapping.
tokens amount is subtracted from the source balance.
tokens amount is subtracted from the allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
spender parameter selects the allowance entry read by allowance.
from parameter indexes balances in the transferFrom subtraction.
from parameter indexes the allowance mapping in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter selects the balance/allowance entry read by allowance.
balances mapping is read and written by the transfer subtraction.
balances mapping is read and written by the transfer addition.
balances mapping is read and written by the transferFrom subtraction.
allowed mapping is written by approve.
allowed mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
totalSupply state variable is assigned from the mint arithmetic.
SafeMath.sub is invoked to perform the transfer balance decrement.
SafeMath.add is invoked to perform the transfer balance increment.
SafeMath.sub is invoked to perform the transferFrom balance decrement.
SafeMath.sub is invoked to perform the allowance decrement.
Unchecked multiplication semantics underpin the totalSupply computation.
